strategy: Replace with balanced binary trees of gates
rationale: Reduces critical-path depth from O(n) to O(log n) for parity and accumulate reductions without changing functionality
area_cost: small; XOR and adder trees have identical gate count to serial chains, just rearranged
equivalence_argument: Parity: XOR is associative and commutative; tree order doesn't change result. Accumulation: addition is associative (modulo overflow, which occurs identically for same input widths). Both reset to 0 in the same cycle. Intermediate widths unchanged—all intermediate sums at each tree level are DW+4 bits, same as serial chain.
